operator_request: Comparar os Velaryon com os Frey para observar a diferença efetiva associada à skill mais alta.
interpretation: Velaryon means Velaryon Marksman; Frey means Frey Assassin, the control named in the immediately preceding selection.

design.question: ranged_attack
design.secondary_question: Does the Frey package, with 250 Crossbow, outperform the Velaryon package with 130 Crossbow despite lower base crossbow damage and fewer bolts?
design.skill_role: secondary_after_weapon_comparison; explicit operator question, no coefficient inferred
design.projectile_contribution: Different bolt items and raw bolt damage retained as confounders; no assumed engine damage-addition formula.
design.weapon_speed: Raw ratings are not shots per second. No reload or accuracy effect size is inferred from skill points.
design.roster_policy: Both audited troops have one roster; keep any observed runtime equipment changes separate.
design.armor_policy: Different armor retained as a confounder; no new armor composite or general score.

setup.formation: One shared ranged formation on the player side, same captain and orders; loose spacing with unobstructed line of sight. Do not put the two units against each other.
setup.support: Keep infantry support similar; avoid other elite ranged anchors taking most available kills.
setup.orders: Hold a ranged position; do not intentionally charge the targets into melee.
setup.count_policy: Use actual independently deployed troops from the same battle, not planned strength or final survivors. Record unequal counts/reinforcements instead of guessing.
setup.shared_formation_limit: Shared formation reduces commander/order asymmetry but does not guarantee identical slot position, exposure or target selection.
setup.party_captain_policy: Keep party leader, captain, perks, difficulty, mods and applicable buffs stable; base skill/ammo exports are not guaranteed runtime effective values.
setup.version_policy: Inputs are from the pinned repository export; exact equivalence to the live installation is unverified.

required: Both troop rows at the same observation endpoint
All visible ordinary troop rows; focus is additive, not a filter
capture.endpoint: Final result, or the valid last observation before a bug-stopped battle; flag interrupted observations.
capture.optional: One shared pre-melee scoreboard can document an additional ranged-phase view, not another independent battle. Record known melee contact, cover asymmetry, reinforcements or ammo exhaustion; unknown stays unknown.
capture.no_scoreboard_accuracy_inference: Final kills alone do not measure shots fired, hit rate, reload time or which weapon caused each kill.

analysis_contract.independent_unit: battle_id; never troop appearances or number of screenshots
analysis_contract.paired_subset: Both canonical IDs observed on the player side in the same field battle and the same endpoint, with verified positive deployed counts. Unpaired observations stay in batch-wide outputs, not the paired contrast.
analysis_contract.primary_metric: delta_b = kills_frey_b / deployed_frey_b - kills_velaryon_b / deployed_velaryon_b; report each battle and the unweighted mean and median delta across independent paired battles.
analysis_contract.relative_difference: If the Velaryon rate is positive: rate_frey / rate_velaryon - 1. If its rate is zero, percentage is undefined; retain the absolute delta and raw counts without epsilon or infinity.
companion_metrics: Each troop kill share and deployment share within the player side using direct same-side totals
Pair kill share, named separately from whole-army share
Deaths, wounded and retention with separate meanings; zero deaths is not assumed to mean zero casualties
Wins/losses/ties of the within-battle kills-per-deployed comparison
Sensitivity excluding interrupted endpoints and clear melee/visibility asymmetry, while retaining all originals
analysis_contract.five_battle_gate: At least 5 independent paired battles and 20 deployed per troop permit a reviewed comparison, not causal identification or an automatic winner.
analysis_contract.historical_rule: Do not pool old Frey-only cohorts with this paired cohort or compare the old overall mean as if it were a matched control. Preserve the existing Frey closure.
analysis_contract.no_normalization_by_prior_index: Do not divide kills by 4000/3348, or convert +120 Crossbow points into a skill multiplier.
analysis_contract.causal_language: Report the observed stock-troop package contrast. A Frey advantage is compatible with skill helping, but bolts, armor, other skills, positioning and AI remain alternative explanations; a Velaryon win does not prove skill is irrelevant.

isolated_skill_followup_design.purpose: Estimate the effect of Crossbow 130 versus 250 without changing the rest of the troop.
isolated_skill_followup_design.base_identity: One identical test troop cloned under separate experimental IDs; never silently edit the campaign troops.
isolated_skill_followup_design.only_intended_difference: Crossbow skill; all other skills, equipment, appearance/body parameters, health, level, culture, AI settings and effects identical.
hold_equal: Counts, opponent composition, scene, range, terrain, weather and orders
isolated_skill_followup_design.randomization: Swap or randomize spawn-side/positions across independent replications; record the fixed opponent composition in a versioned fixture before running.
isolated_skill_followup_design.measurement: Kills/deployed over the same fixed opportunity window, with optional measured shots/hits/reload times; do not estimate these from final kills.
isolated_skill_followup_design.scope: Results are specific to that controlled profile; keep separate from stock campaign and siege aggregates.
